title: We have online multiplayer in INFEST! How Claude helped connect the browser and Windows demos
author: Illustrious-Lake2603
selftext:
INFEST: The Arcade now has online multiplayer. The free demo has Team Deathmatch, free-for-all Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, and Infect on Wreck Basin. You can join from a desktop browser or the Windows build.



Claude helped wire Unity’s lobby browser to our relay. The lobby cards read the actual open rooms and player counts from the relay, and both the WebGL and Windows builds use the same pool of rooms. That means one player can create a room in the browser and another can look for it or join by code from Windows.



If you try it with a friend, I’d love feedback on that first trip from Online to a match. Could you find each other’s room? If you had to stop and figure something out, where was it? Browser-to-Windows tests would be especially helpful.



Free demo: [https://panic-blazeit.itch.io/infest-the-arcade](https://panic-blazeit.itch.io/infest-the-arcade)
